corpus: Fictional aerospace supplier quality records (tests/fixtures/quality_bench), version 1
purpose: Answer-level evaluation for the supplier-quality pilot. scripts/pilot_eval.py runs every case against a live deployment, applies the automatic checks below, and writes a review sheet; a quality engineer then marks each answer. The automatic checks are screening aids, not a verdict: an answer passes only when a reviewer says every material claim is supported by the passage it cites.

fields.kind: revision | effectivity | conflict | audit | deviation | cross-document | table | identifier | scope | unanswerable
fields.must_mention: Groups of alternatives; each group needs at least one match (case-insensitive substring).
fields.flag_values: Strings that suggest a stale revision or the wrong part. Flagged for the reviewer, never failed automatically: an answer may quote the old value to explain the change.
fields.expected_sources: Filenames at least one of which should be cited.
fields.abstain: True when the records do not settle the question; the answer should say so instead of guessing.
fields.selected_sources: Restrict the question to these filenames (document_ids on /ask).

cases.question: What torque do the mounting screws on the 7731-204 bracket get?
cases.expect: 32 in-lb ±2 per WI-2140 rev G (ECN-0419), from lot 2611 on. If 28 in-lb is mentioned it must be identified as revision F / drawing rev K.

cases.question: Lot 2608 of the 7731-204 bracket: which torque applied when it was built?
cases.expect: 28 in-lb ±2 (drawing rev K / WI-2140 rev F). ECN-0419 applies from lot 2611; earlier lots are not reworked unless Aldermark asks. Here the older value is the right one.

cases.question: The Cell 4 shift note says the 204 brackets get 28 in-lb. Is that right?
cases.expect: No for lot 2611 onward: WI-2140 rev G requires 32 ±2 in-lb. The shift note is informal and outdated; IA-2026-03 finding 3 recommends removing it.

cases.question: How many working days does the MRB have to disposition an NCR?
cases.expect: 5 working days under QP-8.7 rev D (effective 2026-06-15), then escalation to the Quality Manager. Rev C's 10 days is superseded.
expected_sources: QP-8.7 Control of Nonconforming Output rev D.md

cases.question: Is NCR-2026-0141 within our disposition time limit?
cases.expect: No. Opened 2026-09-08 and still pending MRB; IA-2026-03 found it open 12 working days against the 5 allowed by QP-8.7 rev D, and not escalated.
expected_sources: QP-8.7 Control of Nonconforming Output rev D.md

cases.question: Can NCR-2026-0150 be dispositioned use-as-is under SD-2026-017?
cases.expect: No. SD-2026-017 covers lots 2604-2606 of 7731-210 only and expired 2026-09-30; NCR-0150 is lot 2609. Use-as-is on an Aldermark part needs a new written SDR (QP-8.7 rev D).

cases.question: Lots 2611 and 2612 were torqued with TW-08 after its calibration fell due. What do our procedures require?
cases.expect: QP-7.1.5 rev E: overdue equipment is tagged DO NOT USE and removed; if found out of tolerance at calibration, an impact assessment of every lot measured since the last good calibration within 2 working days. The records do not say whether TW-08 was found out of tolerance. CAR-2026-022 is open, due 2026-11-30.
expected_sources: QP-7.1.5 Calibration of measuring equipment rev E.md

cases.question: Does ECN-0419 require a first article inspection?
cases.expect: Yes: a partial (delta) FAI to AS9102 for the changed torque characteristic on the first lot built to drawing rev L; consistent with SQR-100's FAI-after-design-change rule.
expected_sources: Aldermark SQR-100 Supplier quality requirements rev 9.md

cases.question: If lot 2611 shipped with missing torque stripes, how quickly must Aldermark be told?
cases.expect: Within 24 hours of discovery (QP-8.7 rev D escapes; SQR-100 rev 9 notification), with containment at the customer's dock and at Corvane.
expected_sources: QP-8.7 Control of Nonconforming Output rev D.md
Aldermark SQR-100 Supplier quality requirements rev 9.md

cases.question: Which NCRs in the 2026 log are still open, and on which part numbers?
What torque do the screws on the 7731-240 bracket get?
cases.expect: 45 in-lb ±3 per WI-2155 rev B. Not the 7731-204 values.

cases.question: What torque do the mounting screws on the 7731-204 bracket get?
cases.expect: Within the selected source only: 28 ±2 in-lb, and the answer should say this revision has been replaced (by rev G). It must not cite documents outside the selection.

cases.question: Who at Aldermark approved SD-2026-017?
cases.expect: The deviation names Aldermark Aerospace and the date (2026-04-22) but no person. Do not offer R. Okafor or T. Lindqvist, who approved ECN-0419 at Corvane.

cases.question: What did ECN-0419 cost to implement?
cases.expect: No cost appears in the records.

cases.question: How many NCRs did Cell 4 raise in 2025?
cases.expect: The log covers 2026 only; 2025 counts are not in the records.
